name: save-boot-7d-world-kalm-stream
description: Diagnostic for #140, attempt 2 (notes/140-world-live.md). Load as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3), then 600 frames. Then a mark and 120 frames of Up; the script ends while Up is held, so the values are read during the input. Reported: whether the world's button flag D_800E55FC is set (btn_ok) and the reason it was last cleared (btn_ctx), the frames with 3+ map blocks queued (pend), streaming on (stream), the move request (move_req), D_801163D4 (sub_state; 2 holds the player), whether the map block queue is empty (queue_empty), and the sign of pool element 7's pos.vx change since the mark (x_dir).

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; field 1, world 3 confirmed).

btn_ok.description: World overlay D_800E55FC (s32, low half), returned by func_800A21A4: set to 1 at load, cleared by func_800A2108(0, n) (which records n in D_800E5600), for example when map blocks stay queued for 300 frames. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

btn_ctx.description: World overlay D_800E5600 (s32, low half): the reason func_800A2108(0, n) last cleared D_800E55FC (4 = the map-loading stall in func_800A41E8). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

pend.description: World overlay D_800E5818 (s32, low half): frames in a row with 3 or more map blocks queued (WmUpdateStreamingAndCamera); at 300 the world fades out and clears D_800E55FC. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

stream.description: World overlay D_800E5828 (s32, low half): streaming on (1 after InitWorldState). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

move_req.description: World overlay D_80109D64 (s32, low half): 1 = move the player by D_80109D68 this frame (WmUpdateStreamingAndCamera), 2 = set by func_800A886C. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

sub_state.description: World overlay D_801163D4 (s32, low half), returned by func_800BC1AC: 2 holds the player still (WmMovePcEntityByDistance(0)). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

queue.description: World overlay D_800E5768: head of the queue of map blocks to load (WmGetNumberOfMapToLoad counts it); 0 when empty. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

pos_x.description: Pool element 7 + 0x0C pos.vx (s32). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor.
